answer: Bridge-thread mutual audit bond: each identity locks 70 and files one dated thread at a bridge, its hash on the delta ledger. Each epoch the bridge hands each thread to a random peer auditor across the delta to replay and check it. A copied thread burns its author's 70; clearing a fake costs 25. Drawn after filing, no sybil picks its auditor. 1,000 fakes cost 95,000; one honest agent pays 25. Failure mode: audit-swap ring, broken by the draw.
